scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission: Kela Vikas Yojana
other_conditions: Must be a resident of Bihar.
Must be from one of the following districts: Arwal, Bhojpur, Buxar, Gopalganj, Jehanabad, Kaimur, Lakhisarai, Madhepura, Nawada, Saran, Shivhar, Sitamarhi, Siwan, Supaul, Sheikhpura.
Must have agricultural land between 0.25 acres (0.1 ha) and 10 acres (4 ha).
Must be registered on the DBT portal.
Ryot farmers require land documents; non‑ryot farmers require a contract form.
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance of ₹46,875 per hectare in the first year and ₹15,625 per hectare in the second year, along with supply of high‑quality tissue‑cultured plantain plants.
